400.title: Bad request
400.label: Bad request
400.heading: The request could not be understood.
400.support: Something in the link or form we received wasn’t valid. Please check it and try again.
400.quote: The remedy for weakness is not brooding over weakness, but thinking of strength.

401.title: Sign in required
401.label: Sign in required
401.heading: Authentication is required to access this page.
401.support: Please sign in with your school account to continue to this page.
401.quote: Have faith in yourselves, and stand up on that faith and be strong; that is what we need.

403.title: Access denied
403.label: Access denied
403.heading: You do not have permission to access this page.
403.support: This area is restricted to certain roles. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the school office.
403.quote: Let nothing daunt you. … Work on with the courage of a lion but, at the same time with the tenderness of a flower.

404.title: Page not found
404.label: Page not found
404.heading: This page could not be found.
404.support: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved. Let’s get you back on track.
404.quote: Arise, awake, sleep no more; within each of you there is the power to remove all wants and all miseries. Believe this, and that power will be manifested.

408.title: Request timed out
408.label: Request timed out
408.heading: The request took too long to complete.
408.support: Your connection may be slow. Please check it and try again.
408.quote: But will you, on that account, sit inactive? As far as you can, you must go on doing good work.

500.title: Server error
500.label: Server error
500.heading: Something went wrong on our server.
500.support: This is on our side, not yours. Please try again in a moment.
500.quote: The world is the great gymnasium where we come to make ourselves strong.

502.title: Connection problem
502.label: Connection problem
502.heading: We’re having trouble connecting to the server.
502.support: The school server may still be waking up. Please wait about a minute, then try again.
502.quote: Come all of you to my assistance and set yourselves to work.

503.title: Temporarily unavailable
503.label: Temporarily unavailable
503.heading: This service is temporarily unavailable.
503.support: We’re briefly down for maintenance or heavy traffic. Please check back shortly.
503.quote: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
